report.advertisedClaim: The advertised claim is unverified: the user states Delta's site says 'no change fees' for Basic Economy, but no offer page with this exact claim was found. Official policy pages state Basic Economy tickets are nonrefundable after 24 hours, with no changes or refunds allowed except for a 24-hour risk-free cancellation window.
report.policyFinding: Delta's official policy states that Basic Economy tickets are nonrefundable and cannot be changed or refunded after the 24-hour risk-free cancellation period. If you cancel more than 24 hours after booking, you will not receive a cash refund. The only exception is if Delta cancels or significantly changes your flight, or as required by law.
report.explanation: Delta Basic Economy tickets are nonrefundable and cannot be changed or refunded after the 24-hour risk-free cancellation period. If you cancel three days after booking, you will not get a cash refund. You may receive an eCredit only in rare circumstances (such as a Delta-initiated cancellation or significant schedule change). The 'no change fees' language does not apply to Basic Economy, which is explicitly excluded from change/refund eligibility after 24 hours.
importantConditions: Full cash refund only available if canceled within 24 hours of booking (risk-free cancellation).
After 24 hours, Basic Economy tickets are nonrefundable and non-changeable.
No cash refund after 24 hours unless Delta cancels or significantly changes your flight, or as required by law.
No eCredit unless specifically allowed by a Delta-initiated event or special circumstance.

evidence.excerpt: Note: Customers who purchase Delta Main Basic (Basic Economy) will not be able to change or refund their ticket after the Risk-Free Cancellation period.

Ticket changes or refunds not allowed after the Risk-Free Cancellation period. Basic Economy travelers are not eligible for paid or complimentary access or upgrades to premium seats, including to Delta Comfort+® or Preferred Seats.
Once you've bought a qualifying eTicket, you have a day to cancel it for any reason and receive a full refund—including any prepaid fees and Direct Ticketing Charges—with no cancellation fee.

When you purchase Delta Main Basic, you typically will enjoy our lowest fare, but seats will be assigned after check-in and you will not be able to refund your ticket after the Risk-Free Cancellation period.
